conclusion.rationale: CAN ID 420 at start bit 16, width 16 bits (little-endian) achieves the highest correlation (0.9999999957) and best linear fit metrics (RMSE 0.002738, MAE 0.002249, R^2 ~ 1.0) across all 6000 aligned frames. The raw integer values span 0 to 9001, which does not exercise the sign bit; hence signed and unsigned interpretations produce identical decoded series on this capture and cannot be distinguished. Layout confidence is therefore medium while signal confidence is high.

alternative_candidates.reason: Bit-shifted 16-bit layout on CAN ID 420 with lower correlation and higher RMSE/MAE.
Sub-byte 12-bit slice on CAN ID 420 with higher reconstruction error metrics.
Candidate on CAN ID 790 with substantially higher residual errors (RMSE 0.529 vs 0.0027).
